agentStop.bash: agentflow stop-gate || { r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ -f "$r/.agent/plan.lock.json" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"agentflow stop-gate could not run. Install or upgrade agentflow-proof to 1.9.0 or later so the agentflow command is on PATH, then try to stop again."}'; else printf '{}\n'; fi; }
agentStop.powershell: agentflow stop-gate; if (-not $?) { if (Test-Path .agent/plan.lock.json) { '{"decision":"block","reason":"agentflow stop-gate could not run. Install or upgrade agentflow-proof to 1.9.0 or later so the agentflow command is on PATH, then try to stop again."}' } else { '{}' } }
